title: Best Air Fryer Microwave Combos
description: Compare the best air fryer microwave combos — Toshiba OptiChef, GE, BLACK+DECKER, Frigidaire, Breville Combi Wave, Ninja Crispi microwave, Panasonic, and Samsung — ranked for countertop space-saving and crisp results.
evidenceRequirement: Combo-fit ranking from capacity, wattage, and cooking functions; thoughtful buy-if / skip-if.

summary: For an air fryer microwave combo, prioritize real air-fry performance plus everyday microwave speed in one footprint. We ranked Toshiba OptiChef and inverter combos, GE and BLACK+DECKER 4–5-in-1 units, Frigidaire, Breville Combi Wave, Ninja Crispi microwave, Panasonic HomeChef, and Samsung convection models by capacity, functions, and practical cleanup. Use Check Price to confirm today’s Amazon details before buying.

sections.heading: Who should buy and who should skip
paragraphs: Buy a microwave + air fryer combo if you want one appliance for reheating and crisping without a separate air fryer on the counter.
Skip combos if you already love a dedicated basket air fryer and only need a basic microwave — two specialized tools can outperform one hybrid for heavy air frying.
bullets: Small kitchens → compact 0.9–1.0 cu ft combos
Families → 1.2–1.5 cu ft convection / OptiChef models
Premium crisp + microwave → Breville / Panasonic / Ninja Crispi microwave

sections.heading: What matters in an air fryer microwave combo
paragraphs: Look for dedicated air-fry or crisp modes, enough interior height for a crisp tray, and controls you will actually use for weeknight reheating.
Inverter models often reheat more evenly; convection + air fry helps browning for frozen foods and leftovers.
bullets: Air fry / crisp mode + microwave in one body
Clear capacity (cu ft) and included crisp tray/basket
Easy-clean interior after oily air frying

sections.heading: How we ranked the products
paragraphs: Ranking follows combo usefulness (listed air-fry functions), capacity, brand/feature clarity, and value. Specialty premium units rank high for performance; simpler digital air-fry microwaves rank high for everyday value.

faqs.question: Is an air fryer microwave combo as good as a basket air fryer?
faqs.answer: Combos are excellent for space and convenience. Dedicated basket fryers often crisp larger batches faster — choose based on counter space and how often you air fry.

faqs.question: What size combo microwave should I buy?
faqs.answer: About 0.9–1.0 cu ft fits most singles and couples. Choose 1.2 cu ft or larger if you reheat family plates or want more air-fry tray space.

faqs.question: Do I need an inverter model?
faqs.answer: Inverter microwaves often reheat more evenly. They cost more, but help if you microwave leftovers and delicate foods often.

faqs.question: Can these replace my oven?
faqs.answer: No — they handle microwave, air fry, and some bake/roast tasks, but not full-size oven capacity. Use Check Price and the listing functions before you buy.
